newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks slightly firmer in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks slightly firmer in London trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks were slightly firmer in light trading in London on Tuesday, dealers said.

By 1455 GMT the Nikkei/ISE-50 index was up 3.63 points at 1,316.85. Overnight the key Nikkei-225 closed 122.18 points lower at 17,358.16 because of worries about the economy and government economic policy.
"There's been quite a bit of selling pressure on some hi-tech stocks and buying interest in banks that have been weak recently, as well as a bit of bargain-hunting," said one dealer.
"The market is mixed, that's the best way to describe it," he said.
